entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
------
For the Petitioner : Mrs. Jasvindar Mazumdar, Advocate : Mr. Nishant Kr. Roy, Advocate For the State : Mrs. V.K. Vashistha, Spl. P.P.
------
Order No.02 Dated- 18.10.2023 Heard the parties.
Apprehending his arrest, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail in connection with Ramgarh (Mahila) P.S. Case No.14 of 2023 registered under sections 376 of the Indian Penal Code.

The Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegation against the petitioner is that the petitioner promised to marry the victim and repeatedly sexually exploited her after calling her several times but later on refused to marry the victim and victim consumed analgesic tablets after preparing a video and the petitioner took the victim to hospital after assaulting her on the way.

It is further submitted that the allegations against the petitioner are all false and there is a delay in lodging the FIR and the allegation goes to show that there was consensual sexual relationship between the parties.
It is then submitted that both the petitioner and the informant are adult persons hence, the offence of rape is not made out.
It is then submitted that the petitioner undertakes to furnish sufficient security including cash security and also undertakes to cooperate with the investigation of the case.
Hence, it is submitted that the petitioner be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
Learned Spl. P.P. opposes the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: Considering the submissions of the counsels and the fact as discussed above, I am of the opinion that it is a fit case where the above named petitioner be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.

Hence, in the event of his arrest or surrender within a period of eight weeks from the date of this order, he shall be released on bail on depositing cash security of Rs. 1,00,000/- and on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned C.J.M., Ramgarh, in connection with Ramgarh (Mahila) P.S. Case No.14 of 2023 with the condition that the petitioner will cooperate with the investigation of the case and appear before the Investigating Officer as and when noticed by him and will furnish his mobile number and a copy of his Aadhar Card in the court below with the undertaking that he will not change his mobile number during the pendency of the case subject to the conditions laid down under section 438 (2) Cr. P.C. (Anil Kumar Choudhary, J.) Sonu/Gunjan- Deepak Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand ... Opposite ... on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193874562/
